correctness.rationale: The ascent graph has interval components and its connected components coincide with those of the cover graph. Hence skew factors have at least size minus one covers; b is skew-additive. Exact geometric-series extraction gives the finite rational P_r formula, deg P_r<=2r and P_r(1)=1. The binomial expansion proves exact polynomiality for n>=2r and explicit leading/second terms; a standalone verifier independently checks 409113 permutations and the rational slices. The all-n proof is mathematical, not finite extrapolation.

value.rationale: For an explicit open-ended enumeration problem associated with boxed pattern 12 and strong-Bruhat up-degree, the result gives every fixed-degree slice at all lengths, exact rational generating functions, a finite coefficient algorithm, sharp eventual polynomial degree and two leading coefficients. It also establishes the local-increasing head of the conjectured unimodal distribution for arbitrarily wide but fixed windows. This is a motivated infinite structural theorem rather than finite data, a direct textbook corollary or an unmotivated single coefficient.
